title: Gilded Theme
description: 1.21.1 Dark themed Texturepack with a purple gilded trim: Clean and Simple
body:
![Gilded Theme](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82676660c08e5edad2f5106094d9d2d3162edb1a_0.webp)

Gilded theme is a 1.21.1 Texturepack created for the Avarice Modpack.

This texture pack features a clean and simple black Dark mode GUI base, with a clean gilded purple trim. Elevate your GUI experience With Gilded UI!
